S = np.diag([-10.0, 0.0, 10.0])
W = np.diag([(15.0 + k * 20.0) ** 2 for k in (-1, 0, 1)])
A2, A1, A0 = C, S @ C + C @ S, S @ C @ S - W
def pack(d):
    values = np.asarray(d['wavenumbers'], dtype=complex)
    modes = np.asarray(d['mode_shapes'], dtype=complex)
    pieces = [np.asarray([values.ndim, values.size, modes.ndim] + list(modes.shape), dtype=float), values.real.ravel(), values.imag.ravel(), np.asarray([d['max_abs_imag']], dtype=float)]
    if modes.ndim == 2:

        pieces.append(norms)
        for mode, norm in zip(modes.T, norms):
            unit = mode / norm if np.isfinite(norm) and norm > 0.0 else np.full(mode.shape, np.nan + 0j)
            projector = np.outer(unit, np.conjugate(unit))
            pieces.extend((projector.real.ravel(), projector.imag.ravel()))

import numpy as np
import scipy.linalg as sla
def build(n, am, w, r, km, wm):
    o = np.arange(-n, n + 1, dtype=float)
    C = np.zeros((2 * n + 1, 2 * n + 1))
    d = o[:, None] - o[None, :]
    C[d == 0] = 1.0
    C[np.abs(d) == 1] = am / 2.0
    S = np.diag(o * km)
    W = np.diag((w + o * wm) ** 2)
    A2, A1, A0 = C, S @ C + C @ S, S @ C @ S - r * W
    m = 2 * n + 1
    L = np.block([[np.zeros((m, m)), np.eye(m)], [-A0, -A1]])
    R = np.block([[np.eye(m), np.zeros((m, m))], [np.zeros((m, m)), A2]])
    v, x = sla.eig(L, R)
    x = x[:m, :] / np.linalg.norm(x[:m, :], axis=0)
    k = np.lexsort((v.imag, v.real))
    return np.asarray(v[k], dtype=complex), np.ascontiguousarray(x[:, k]), C
V, X, C = build(3, 0.3, 15.0, 1.0, 10.0, 20.0)
def invariant_modes(modes):
    modes = np.asarray(modes, dtype=complex)
    pieces = [np.asarray([modes.ndim] + list(modes.shape), dtype=float)]
    if modes.ndim == 2:
        norms = np.linalg.norm(modes, axis=0)
        pieces.append(norms)
        for mode, norm in zip(modes.T, norms):
            unit = mode / norm if np.isfinite(norm) and norm > 0.0 else np.full(mode.shape, np.nan + 0j)
            projector = np.outer(unit, np.conjugate(unit))
            pieces.extend((projector.real.ravel(), projector.imag.ravel()))
    return np.concatenate(pieces)
def pack(d):
    forward = np.asarray(d['forward_wavenumbers'], dtype=complex)
    backward = np.asarray(d['backward_wavenumbers'], dtype=complex)
    group = np.asarray(d['group_velocities'], dtype=complex)
    header = np.asarray([forward.ndim, forward.size, backward.ndim, backward.size, group.ndim, group.size], dtype=float)
    return np.concatenate((header, forward.real.ravel(), forward.imag.ravel(), backward.real.ravel(), backward.imag.ravel(), group.real.ravel(), group.imag.ravel(), invariant_modes(d['forward_modes']), invariant_modes(d['backward_modes'])))
assert np.allclose(pack(directional_mode_families(np.array(V, copy=True),np.array(X, copy=True),np.array(C, copy=True), 15.0, 1.0, 10.0, 20.0)), target)
